speaker: Unknown
en: Every single experiment was training a language model on a massive data set, which is fine when the competition is over four weeks, but in a workshop like today, you'd never actually be able to see your auto research run.
zh: 每一个实验都是在一个大规模数据集上训练语言模型，如果比赛持续四周这没问题，但在像今天这样的工作坊里，你根本不可能真正看到你的 auto research 跑起来。

en: So think of MiniPG as a scale model of the challenge.
zh: 所以把 MiniPG 想成是这个挑战赛的缩比模型。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: But what we did is we shrank this in scale.
zh: 但我们所做的是把它在规模上缩小了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're using a tiny data set instead of fine web, and training an eval that only takes a few minutes.
zh: 我们用一个微型数据集代替 fine web,训练加评估只需要几分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you'll actually be able to get a loop going.
zh: 所以你真的能把一个循环跑起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And see several real steps live.

zh: 你们要自己在 MiniParameterGolf 上运行 auto research。

en: And the other is Modal, the compute your experiments, train and evaluate on.
zh: 另一个是 Modal,你的实验在其中训练和评估的计算平台。

speaker: Unknown
en: Free credits, thank you, Modal.
zh: 免费额度，谢谢你，Modal。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then you will clone our parameter golf repo and hand it to your coding agent, tell it to kick off a run, it handles the setup, and it will start the loop.
zh: 然后你会克隆我们的 parameter golf 仓库，把它交给你的编码智能体，让它启动一次运行，它负责环境搭建，并开始跑循环。

speaker: Unknown
en: Once it's going and it's running in the background, you can kick it off, and we will check back in in around 15 or 20 minutes to take you inside the details.
zh: 一旦它跑起来、在后台运行，你就可以启动它，我们会在大约 15 到 20 分钟后回来带你们深入细节。

en: Instructions are here.

speaker: Unknown
en: If you run into any issues or have any questions, feel free to scan the QR code and enter it there, and we'll be monitoring that, or raise your hand and we'll come to you.
zh: 如果你遇到任何问题或有任何疑问，随时扫描二维码并在那里输入，我们会监控那个频道，或者举手，我们会过去找你。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll check back in in around 10, 15 minutes.
zh: 我们会在大约 10 到 15 分钟后回来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thanks, guys.
zh: 谢谢各位。

speaker: Unknown
en: All right.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So sorry about the internet problem.
zh: 对于网络问题非常抱歉。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it's being worked on.
zh: 我觉得正在处理中。

speaker: Unknown
en: But until then, I think it would be good to maybe go through the anatomy of an auto-research run.
zh: 但在那之前，我觉得可以先过一遍一次 auto-research 运行的结构剖析。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're going to be doing this in the context of WeCo as the auto-research system and MiniPG as the task.
zh: 我们将以 WeCo 作为 auto-research 系统、MiniPG 作为任务为例来讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: But really, this kind of contract that we have here is fairly general.
zh: 但实际上，我们这里的这种契约是相当通用的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Most auto-research systems are going to have you ask very similar questions and think about the same things.
zh: 大多数 auto-research 系统都会让你问非常相似的问题、思考相同的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, so the first thing is the source file.
zh: 好，那么第一件事是源文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is what the agent actually has to modify.
zh: 这是智能体实际需要修改的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: This defines the search space and where it can make changes.
zh: 它定义了搜索空间以及它可以进行更改的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this can be a single file, it can be multiple files.
zh: 它可以是单个文件，也可以是多个文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the case of Minipg, it's this one file called solution.py.
zh: 在 Minipg 这个例子里，它是一个叫 solution.py 的文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And solution.py essentially defines the model config and the training dynamics that's gonna go on while the model is training.
zh: 而 solution.py 本质上定义了模型配置以及模型训练过程中的训练动态。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the second thing, and in my opinion this is probably the most crucial part of an auto-research system, is the evaluation.
zh: 然后第二件事，在我看来这可能是 auto-research 系统最关键的部分，就是评估。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so you want to have a very simple way of allowing your auto-research system to evaluate every solution that it generates.
zh: 你需要有一种非常简单的方式，让你的 auto-research 系统能够评估它生成的每一个方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you want to have it output a single scalar metric.
zh: 而且你要让它输出一个单一的标量指标。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you want the eval to be fast, you want it to be cheap, you want it to have low noise, because this essentially leads to your ability to run more steps if you have a fixed budget or a fixed time constraint.
zh: 你希望评估要快、要便宜、要低噪声，因为这本质上决定了在固定预算或固定时间约束下你能运行更多步数的能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if there's low noise, then both you as well as the agent are more confident as you're kind of hill climbing on whatever task you're auto-researching on.
zh: 而且如果噪声低，那么无论是你还是智能体，在你进行任何 auto-research 任务的爬山优化时都会更有信心。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so one thing to be aware of, though, is agents love to reward hack.
zh: 不过有一点需要注意，那就是智能体特别喜欢钻评估的空子(reward hack)。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they love to find holes in your evaluation protocol, holes in your benchmark.
zh: 它们喜欢在你的评估协议里找漏洞，在你的基准测试里找漏洞。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so you really want to figure out how to make your eval as robust as possible.
zh: 所以你真的要好好琢磨怎么让你的评估尽可能稳健。

speaker: Unknown
en: The next two things are the metric and the goal.
zh: 接下来的两样东西是指标和目标。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you really want to ask yourself two questions.
zh: 你真的要问自己两个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: What do I want to improve?
zh: 我想改进什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: And is higher or lower better?
